battle.name: 中蘇邊界衝突
battle.theater: 黑龍江烏蘇里江與新疆鐵列克提
battle.brief: 一九六九年三月二日至九月十一日，中蘇在黑龍江烏蘇里江與新疆鐵列克提同時動武。三月十五日珍寶島之戰，解放軍以反坦克砲、四〇式無後座力砲同岸上縱深砲火對抗蘇軍戰車與冰雹火箭砲，繳獲一輛六二式戰車；卡面線膛野戰砲雖早百年，仍是現場榴砲的設計母型；九月十日雙方停火，爭端留待談判。

countries: 交戰雙方是中華人民共和國與蘇維埃社會主義共和國，戰線同時鋪在四段邊界上：黑龍江與烏蘇里江主航道的東段、新疆塔城與阿勒泰的西段，以及蒙古人民共和國境內的蘇蒙邊界。中國方面由中共中央軍委直接指導，毛澤東批准在東段動武，林彪以國防部長身分主持軍委會議，具體部署交給沈陽軍區司令員陳錫聯；前線編制以黑龍江軍區邊防團與步兵第三十九師所屬裝甲兵第一團為骨幹，炮兵單位自烏蘇里江中國岸展開縱深射擊。蘇聯方面由遠東軍區司令員奧列格·洛西克統率，第五十八摩托化步兵師由縱深趕赴前沿，邊防總隊司令員德莫克拉特·列昂諾夫上校在前線直接指揮邊防軍，蒙古人民共和國以邊防部隊與航空兵力支援蘇方。交戰方公布的中國方向兵力約八十一萬四千人，蘇方約六十五萬八千人。雙方從未把衝突升格為計畫中的全面戰爭：中共中央刻意限定在局部的邊界衝突，蘇聯高層則一面增兵前線，一面反覆商議報復方案。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the People's Republic of China and the Soviet Union, and the front ran along four stretches of border at once: the eastern sector of the Heilongjiang river and the main channel of the Ussuri, the western sector in the Xinjiang prefectures of Tacheng and Altay, and the Soviet-Mongolian border inside Mongolia. On the Chinese side the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China directed everything: Mao Zedong authorised armed action in the east, Lin Biao chaired the commission meetings as defence minister, and the detailed deployment was handed to Chen Xilian, commander of the Shenyang Military Region. The field order of battle rested on the border guard regiment of the Heilongjiang Military Region and the 1st Tank Regiment of the 39th Infantry Division, while artillery batteries opened up deep fire from the Chinese bank of the Ussuri. On the Soviet side the Far Eastern Military Region under Oleg Losik directed the operation, the 58th Motor Rifle Division came up from the interior, and Colonel Demokrat Leontov, chief of the border guards, personally commanded the frontier troops on the spot; the Mongolian People's Republic supported the Soviets with border units and aviation. The strength figures published by the belligerents put roughly 814,000 men on the Chinese axis and about 658,000 on the Soviet axis. Neither side ever escalated the clash into a planned general war: the Chinese leadership deliberately limited it to a local border conflict, while the Soviet high command reinforced the front and at the same time repeatedly weighed schemes of revenge.
people: On the Chinese side the decisive figures were Mao Zedong, who approved the armed action in the eastern sector and tied it to the tone of the Ninth National Congress of the party due to open in April; Lin Biao, defence minister, who chaired the commission and fixed the scale of the fighting as small-scale operations; and Chen Xilian, commander of the Shenyang Military Region, who carried out the deployment and ordered the border detachments to build positions on the river island in the middle of the Ussuri. Leng Pengfei was one of the front-line commanders and was wounded in the fighting. Sun Yuguo, commander of a border guard company, led the ambush of 2 March that broke up the Soviet patrol which came ashore to drive the Chinese off the island. On the Soviet side stood Leonid Brezhnev, first secretary of the party, and Defence Minister Andrei Grechko, who proposed to Brezhnev that nuclear strikes be used against China; Oleg Losik, commander of the Far Eastern Military Region, who rushed reinforcements to the front; and Colonel Leontov, chief of the border guards, who was killed on 15 March. The participant Colonel Popov left the most vivid testimony, saying that the fighting that day lasted nine hours and that the island changed hands eight times. Alexei Kossygin, chairman of the Soviet Council of Ministers, travelled through Beijing in September on his way back from Ho Chi Minh's funeral in Vietnam and met Zhou Enlai, which cooled the situation. Soviet ambassador to the United States Anatoly Dobrynin met the American national security adviser Henry Kissinger on 20 August to sound out the American position should the Soviet Union attack and destroy Chinese nuclear installations.

kits: 卡面兵器是一八五〇年前後德意志諸邦使用的前膛裝填線膛野戰砲。線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵；但前膛裝填要分裝藥包再以通條搗實，射速低、膛壓低、砲管壽命短，只能靠砲位與彈藥供應取勝。它在一九六九年的珍寶島上根本沒有出現——當日真正開火的是四〇式無後座力砲、反坦克砲、七五式步槍、六三式自動槍、五十九式坦克，以及從烏蘇里江中國岸射來的一二二與一五二毫米榴砲；蘇方則投入六二式與五五式坦克、BMD裝甲車、一二二毫米BM-21冰雹多管火箭砲、一二二與一五二毫米榴砲、直升機與螺旋槳飛機。不過線膛野戰砲正是現場武器的設計母型：普魯士砲廠在後膛裝填與鋼製砲管技術成熟之後，演出一八七七年八公分野戰砲與一八九〇年九公分野戰砲，線膛砲由射程上的優勢品變成各國的標準配備，並經俄羅斯與日本傳入亞洲，蘇聯七六毫米師屬砲與解放軍七五毫米野戰砲都出自同一條譜系，一九六九年解放軍炮兵序列裡的師旅級火力，就是這條線的末端。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a muzzle-loading rifled field gun of the German states around 1850. Rifling let the same powder charge travel further, and artillery could for the first time beat infantry in range; but muzzle loading meant the charge had to be packed in separate bags and rammed home with a sponge, so the rate of fire was low, the chamber pressure was low and the barrel wore out quickly, and victory had to be bought with gun positions and ammunition supply. The gun simply was not on Zhenbao Island in 1969. What actually fired there was the 40mm recoilless rifle, the anti-tank gun, the 7.5mm bolt-action rifle, the 63-type automatic rifle, the 59-type tank, and 122mm and 152mm howitzers firing deep from the Chinese bank of the Ussuri; the Soviet side committed T-62 and T-55 tanks, BMD armoured vehicles, the 122mm BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launcher, 122mm and 152mm howitzers, helicopters and fixed-wing aircraft. All the same, the rifled field gun is the design ancestor of the weapons actually on the island. Once the Prussian gunmakers had combined breech loading with steel barrels, the line produced the 8cm field gun of 1877 and the 9cm field gun of 1890; the rifled gun stopped being an instrument of range advantage and became standard issue everywhere, and it reached Asia by way of Russia and Japan. The Soviet 76mm divisional gun and the Chinese People's Liberation Army 7.5mm field gun both descend from that line, and the divisional artillery of the Chinese army in 1969 was the far end of the same chain.
tactics: 三月二日，蘇軍邊防巡邏隊上島驅逐中方人員，中方守島分隊隱蔽在土堤與叢林之後突然開火，短距離內重創數十名蘇軍，雙方都誤判為對方挑釁，局勢迅速升級。三月十五日蘇軍先派六人偵察組登島確認情況，主力摩托化步兵師隨後由縱深趕到，以坦克與裝甲車在封凍的江面上展開，企圖把守島分隊趕下島去；中方以反坦克砲與四〇式無後座力砲在環島工事內側射擊，坦克部隊封鎖江面通道，岸上榴砲及時提供縱深支援。蘇軍以BM-21火箭砲與榴砲齊射，中方以岸上縱深砲火還擊，島上幾乎沒有遮蔽，陣地正面暴露在對方射界裡，全日交火九小時，島嶼八度易手。守方其後在所有進島路徑埋雷封鎖，蘇方則派爆破組企圖摧毀被擊傷的坦克，最後用炮火擊碎江面冰層令坦克沉沒。三月黑龍江氣溫零下二三十度，封凍的江面可作天然通路，但積雪與低溫限制裝載與補給，雙方後勤都靠公路上的汽車與履帶車晝夜運補。
tacticsEn: On 2 March a Soviet border patrol landed on the island to drive the Chinese off; the Chinese detachment holding the island, concealed behind earth banks and brush, opened fire suddenly and inflicted heavy losses on the patrol at close range. Both sides misread the incident as deliberate provocation and the situation escalated fast. On 15 March the Soviets sent a six-man reconnaissance group ashore first, and the motor rifle division followed at speed from the interior, deploying tanks and armoured cars across the frozen river surface in an attempt to push the island garrison off. The Chinese answered with anti-tank guns and 40mm recoilless rifles firing from the inner side of the ring of island works, while a tank unit closed the river crossings and shore howitzers supplied deep support in time. The Soviets replied with BM-21 rocket salvoes and howitzer fire, the Chinese answered with deep artillery fire from the shore, and since the island offered almost no cover and the positions stood exposed in the enemy's field of fire, the fighting ran for nine hours and the island changed hands eight times. The defenders afterwards mined every route of approach and sealed them; the Soviets sent a demolition team to destroy the disabled tank and finally shattered the ice beneath it with artillery fire so that it sank. In March the temperature in Heilongjiang ran from twenty to thirty degrees below zero, and the frozen river surface served as a natural roadway, but snow and cold limited loads and supply, so both sides ran their logistics by truck and tracked vehicle along the roads, day and night.
data: 兵力方面，交戰方公布的中國方向兵力約八十一萬四千人，蘇聯方向約六十五萬八千人。珍寶島三場戰鬥的實際投入，中方資料為約一百人，蘇方約三百人。傷亡數字各方說法不一：中方資料指珍寶島戰鬥中陣亡約二十人、受傷六十五人；計入四月至七月爭奪戰車與西段戰鬥，整個衝突共陣亡七十二人、受傷六十八人、失蹤一人，其中六十八人安葬於寶清縣烈士陵園，兩人安葬於齊齊哈爾西滿烈士陵園，一人安葬於十八站烈士陵園。蘇方資料為陣亡五十八人、受傷九十四人，另稱中方陣亡二百四十八人。裝備損失方面，三月十五日一輛六二式坦克在封凍江面被地雷炸傷履帶，乘員棄車逃回；三月二十一日爆破組被擊退後，蘇軍以炮火擊碎冰層令坦克沉江；四月二十七日中方海軍潛水員在夜裡將其打撈上岸。八月十三日鐵列克提一支二十八人巡邏分隊（含三名隨軍記者）全部陣亡、一人被俘後遣返，蘇方陣亡二人、受傷十人；七月八日八岔島蘇方一艘巡邏艇沉沒，十七人死亡、六人受傷；六月十日塔斯提蘇軍槍殺中國女牧民孫龍珍，中方邊防部隊還擊，據報擊斃蘇方十八人。
dataEn: On numbers of troops, the belligerents published about 814,000 men on the Chinese axis and roughly 658,000 on the Soviet axis. The actual force committed to the three engagements on Zhenbao Island was, in the Chinese material, about a hundred men against about three hundred Soviet men. Casualty figures differ from source to source. Chinese material records about 20 dead and 65 wounded in the fighting on the island; counting the fight for the tank from April to July and the clashes in the western sector, the whole conflict cost 72 dead, 68 wounded and one missing, of whom 68 were buried in the Baoqing county martyrs cemetery, two in the Ximan martyrs cemetery at Qiqihar and one in the Shibazhan martyrs cemetery. Soviet figures give 58 dead and 94 wounded, and the Soviets also claimed 248 Chinese dead. In equipment losses, a T-62 tank had its track blown off by a mine on the frozen river surface on 15 March and the crew abandoned it; after the demolition team was repulsed on 21 March the Soviets shattered the ice with artillery and sank the tank, and on 27 April Chinese naval divers lifted it out of the water at night. On 13 August at Tielieketi a patrol detachment of 28 men, including three embedded journalists, was wiped out and one man taken prisoner was later repatriated; the Soviets lost 2 dead and 10 wounded. On 8 July at Bacha Island a Soviet patrol boat sank with 17 dead and 6 wounded, and on 10 June at Tasti Soviet troops shot the Chinese herdswoman Sun Longzhen, Chinese border troops returned fire, and eighteen Soviet dead were reported.
cause: 直接導火索是界河島嶼的歸屬。一八六〇年《中俄北京條約》以烏蘇里江為界，但江心島嶼屬於誰一直沒有定論；一九四七年起蘇聯紅軍在島上巡邏，一九六四年中蘇邊界談判時蘇方曾準備把該島讓給中方，因兩國關係惡化而中止。根本背景是意識形態分裂與邊界爭端的合流：赫魯曉夫時代的爭論、文革初期的反蘇修號召、一九六七年紅場事件，加上蘇聯在中蘇邊境一線增兵、在蒙古境內部署中程飛彈，令北京把邊界守備視為生死問題。一九六七年至一九六八年底，烏蘇里江上的七里沁島等地不斷發生巡邏隊衝突，從對罵、推搡升級到棍棒武鬥。一九六八年八月蘇聯入侵捷克斯洛伐克並提出有限主權論，被中共領導層視為對中國安全的挑戰。中方隨後策劃在珍寶島打一場有限反擊，好為九大定調；蘇方則以懲罰性打擊回應，衝突就此升級到雙方都難以收手的地步。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the ownership of an island in the boundary river. The Treaty of Peking of 1860 had set the Ussuri as the border, but which side owned the islands in the river was never settled; Soviet troops had been patrolling the island since 1947, and during the 1964 Sino-Soviet border talks the Soviet side had been ready to hand the island over to China, but the talks were abandoned as relations between the two countries soured. The deeper background was the fusion of the ideological split with the border dispute: the polemics of the Khrushchev era, the anti-Soviet-revisionist calls of the early Cultural Revolution, the Red Square incident of 1967, and above all Soviet reinforcement of the border line and the deployment of medium-range missiles inside Mongolia, which made Beijing treat frontier defence as a question of life and death. From 1967 to the end of 1968 clashes between patrols kept breaking out on the Ussuri, at Qiliqin Island and elsewhere, escalating from shouting and pushing to fights with clubs. In August 1968 the Soviet invasion of Czechoslovakia and the doctrine of limited sovereignty were read in Beijing as a challenge to Chinese security. The Chinese then planned a limited counterstroke on Zhenbao Island to set the tone for the forthcoming party congress, and the Soviets answered with punitive strikes, and the conflict rose to a level neither side could easily pull back from.
impact: 珍寶島之後，蘇聯高層多次商議報復中國，首次明確提出先發制人與核打擊的威脅，國防部長格列奇科甚至建議對中國動用核武器；這把古巴導彈危機之後的冷戰推到核戰爭邊緣，也讓美國重新計算中蘇關係：八月二十日多勃雷寧與基辛格會談，追問蘇聯若攻擊並摧毀中國核設施美國的立場，基辛格答稱中蘇大規模衝突會帶來不可預測的後果，美方不會坐視大戰爆發；八月二十八日《華盛頓明星報》刊出蘇聯擬對中國施行外科手術式核打擊的消息。對中國而言，這場衝突成為重新估計美國的轉折點：一九七二年尼克松訪華與《上海公報》之後中美迅速解凍，中國並於一九七一年恢復在聯合國的席位。軍事上，中國自此推行深挖洞、廣積糧、不稱霸的戰備運動，蘇聯也向邊界持續增兵，危險期延續數年。技術層面還有一項後果：那輛被打撈的六二式坦克經撫順第六四〇九工廠修復後運抵北京，陳列於中國人民革命軍事博物館，成為解放軍自製坦克的藍本。
impactEn: After Zhenbao Island the Soviet high command weighed schemes of revenge against China many times over and for the first time voiced explicitly the threat of a preventive or nuclear strike; Defence Minister Grechko even proposed to Brezhnev that nuclear weapons be used. The affair pushed the Cold War after the Cuban missile crisis to the edge of nuclear war, and forced Washington to recalculate the Sino-Soviet relationship. On 20 August Dobrynin met Kissinger and asked what the United States would do should the Soviet Union attack and destroy Chinese nuclear installations; Kissinger answered that a large-scale Sino-Soviet conflict would have unpredictable consequences and that America would not let a great war break out. On 28 August the Washington Star printed a story that the Soviet Union intended a surgical nuclear strike on China. For China the clash became the turning point at which the United States was revalued: after Nixon's visit of 1972 and the Shanghai Communiqué Sino-American relations thawed quickly, and China recovered its seat in the United Nations in 1971. Militarily China launched the nationwide readiness campaign of digging deep tunnels, storing grain and claiming no hegemony, while the Soviet Union kept reinforcing the border and the dangerous period stretched on for years. At the technical level there was one more consequence: the T-62 tank pulled out of the river was rebuilt at the 6409 works in Fushun, taken to Beijing and displayed in the Chinese People's Revolution Military Museum, where it became a blueprint for indigenous Chinese tank design.
result: 珍寶島以中方控制全島告終。三月十五日蘇軍邊防總隊司令員列昂諾夫上校陣亡；九月十日雙方邊防軍奉令停火，中方隨即上島屯駐，蘇方此後只做過短暫外交表示，再未提出正式抗議。圍繞那輛戰車的爭奪拖了將近一個月：三月二十一日爆破組被擊退，蘇軍以炮火擊碎冰層令坦克沉入烏蘇里江，四月二十七日中方海軍潛水員在夜裡把它撈上岸，經撫順第六四〇九工廠修復後運抵北京陳列。外交層面，五月二十四日中國政府發表《關於中蘇邊界問題的聲明》，十月七日再發聲明；六月十三日蘇聯政府也發表聲明。九月柯西金赴越南參加胡志明葬禮後路過北京與周恩來會晤，兩國同意防止大規模衝突，十月二十日外交部副部長級邊界談判在北京舉行，未取得成果，蘇聯繼續向邊界增兵。東段爭端最終靠停火與實際控制維持，西段鐵列克提的爭議地區則要等到一九九一年蘇聯解體後，由中國與哈薩克斯坦談判才劃歸中國。
resultEn: Zhenbao Island ended under Chinese control. Colonel Leontov, chief of the Soviet border guards, was killed on 15 March; on 10 September both border guards were ordered to stand down, the Chinese immediately established themselves on the island, and the Soviet side made only brief diplomatic representations afterwards and raised no further formal protest. The struggle over the tank dragged on for nearly a month: the demolition team was repulsed on 21 March, the Soviets broke the ice with artillery and sank the tank into the Ussuri, and on 27 April Chinese naval divers brought it ashore in the night, after which it was rebuilt at the 6409 works in Fushun and taken to Beijing for display. On the diplomatic plane the Chinese government issued a statement on the Sino-Soviet border problem on 24 May and another on 7 October, while the Soviet government published a statement of its own on 13 June. In September Kossygin passed through Beijing on his way back from Ho Chi Minh's funeral in Vietnam and met Zhou Enlai; both sides agreed to prevent a large-scale conflict, and deputy ministerial talks on the border opened in Beijing on 20 October, though without result, while the Soviet Union kept reinforcing the frontier. The eastern dispute was settled in practice by the ceasefire and by facts on the ground, while the disputed area around Tielieketi in the western sector was not assigned to China until 1991, after the collapse of the Soviet Union, through negotiations between China and Kazakhstan.
